FishingSpear.zh: 对食人鱼造成的基础伤害至少为其当前生命的一半。
FishingSpear.en: Base damage against piranhas is at least half their current HP.

Shuriken.zh: 没有手里剑冷却时，投掷不消耗回合；之后进入冷却。
Shuriken.en: Throwing costs no turn while Shuriken Cooldown is absent, then applies the cooldown.

Bolas.zh: 命中时施加5回合残废，目标抗性照常生效。
Bolas.en: Hits apply 5 turns of cripple, subject to target resistance.

Tomahawk.zh: 命中时施加流血，强度随升级等级增长。
Tomahawk.en: Hits cause bleeding whose strength increases with upgrade level.

HeavyBoomerang.zh: 命中或被闪避后，1回合后返回出手位置；使用者仍在那里就自动入包，原位置为空则落地，有其他生物则再次攻击后落地。
HeavyBoomerang.en: Returns to the launch position after 1 turn following a hit or dodge. Collected if the owner is there, dropped if empty, or attacks another occupant before landing.

ForceCube.zh: 冲击落点周围3×3范围，对范围内生物分别判定命中并造成伤害，触发地面机关和植物。
ForceCube.en: Strikes the 3×3 area around impact, rolling hits against each creature and triggering ground mechanisms and plants.

AdrenalineDart.zh: 友军获得10回合激素且不受物理伤害；敌人受到5回合残废。
AdrenalineDart.en: Allies gain 10 turns of adrenaline without physical damage; enemies receive 5 turns of cripple.

ChillingDart.zh: 命中时施加冻伤，水中目标持续更久。
ChillingDart.en: Hits apply chill, lasting longer against targets in water.

CleansingDart.zh: 清除友军减益并给予10回合净化；移除敌人的正面状态和护盾。
CleansingDart.en: Clears allied debuffs and grants 10 turns of cleansing; removes enemy buffs and shields.

DisplacingDart.zh: 将可移动的目标传送到距投掷者8至10格的可达位置。
DisplacingDart.en: Teleports movable targets to a reachable tile 8–10 steps from the thrower.

HealingDart.zh: 清除部分减益并给予持续治疗，友军不受物理伤害。
HealingDart.en: Removes several debuffs and grants healing over time; allies take no physical damage.

HolyDart.zh: 友军获得30回合祝福且不受物理伤害；亡灵和恶魔受到额外神圣伤害。
HolyDart.en: Allies gain 30 turns of blessing without physical damage; undead and demons take extra holy damage.

IncendiaryDart.zh: 命中时点燃目标；未命中落在可燃地形上时会引燃地面并消耗飞镖。
IncendiaryDart.en: Hits ignite targets; landing on flammable ground ignites the tile and consumes the dart.

ParalyticDart.zh: 命中时施加5回合麻痹，目标抗性与免疫照常生效。
ParalyticDart.en: Hits apply 5 turns of paralysis, subject to target resistance and immunity.

PoisonDart.zh: 命中时施加中毒，持续时间受地图层数影响。
PoisonDart.en: Hits apply poison, with duration based on dungeon depth.

RotDart.zh: 命中时施加腐蚀，对首领和小首领的效果较弱。
RotDart.en: Hits apply corrosion, with a weaker effect against bosses and minibosses.

ShockingDart.zh: 命中时造成额外电击伤害。
